test_command: py -3.13 -X utf8 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_*.py -v
audit_scope: Current v3 clusterflow implementation and protocol; old v2 QA reports are not treated as current evidence.
Source graph, stereochemistry, 18O/D retention, component dissociation/proton transfer, masks and explicit property indices.
Real GOAT receipt requirement before import/prescreen; no promotion of unrun starting coordinates.
Full-cluster duplicate metric including identical DMSO component exchange and rigid transformations.
Complete values/weights, full independent TMS ensemble weights, fixed-composition reference matching, CH3 averaging without CH2 collapse.
Missing J data refusal, HF/CF inclusion, experimental sign semantics, source-bound human-reviewed benchmark/convergence gates.
Repeated or disconnected sampling-wave evidence and modified embedded/frozen ensembles rejected.

ASCII scratch staging for Chinese package paths: original-job locks, source/executable/config snapshots, terminal receipt binding, exclusive hash-verified output copy, receipt-last atomic commit and explicit retry preservation.
Final full test discovery includes GOAT transport, downstream portable transport and numeric spectra tests; execution mocks only, no QM launched by this audit.

findings: Individual Nuclei indices are one-based; SpinSpinAtomPairs indices are zero-based.
EPRNMR block follows the coordinate specification.
pcJ-3 and pcJ-2 cover H-He, B-Ne, Al-Ar: sulfur supported, bromine unsupported.
Br J jobs use explicitly declared mixed def2-TZVPP on Br and a distinct actual-applied-basis fingerprint; the mixed model still needs domain validation.

issues_found_and_retested.issue: Windows Unicode package paths failed native RDKit MOL file loading.
issues_found_and_retested.resolution: Python Unicode text reads then MolFromMolBlock; selected fixtures and pipeline tests run from the Chinese package path.

issues_found_and_retested.issue: Analyte fluorine was excluded from J endpoints by the H/C-only shift observation mask.
issues_found_and_retested.resolution: Separate analyte coupling endpoint selection; HF/CF tests pass.

issues_found_and_retested.issue: One-direction component/environment mask validation allowed forged solvent NMR inclusion.
issues_found_and_retested.resolution: Strict component/environment/source-index consistency; forgery tests reject.

issues_found_and_retested.issue: Nonempty but incomplete frequency blocks could pass the optimization/frequency gate.
issues_found_and_retested.resolution: Full 3N frequency dimension required; short-block negative test passes.

issues_found_and_retested.issue: Br mixed-basis J jobs initially shared a fingerprint with light-element-only jobs.
issues_found_and_retested.resolution: Actual Br mixed-basis state is incorporated; distinct-fingerprint test passes.

issues_found_and_retested.issue: Repeated prediction files or unrelated additional completed GOAT starts could appear as convergence evidence.
issues_found_and_retested.resolution: Duplicate results refused and released IDs tied exactly to frozen import-source selection.

issues_found_and_retested.issue: Embedded convergence ensemble could differ from source ensemble while retaining a valid unrelated source hash.
issues_found_and_retested.resolution: Hash-bound frozen ensemble equality and complete final-current-ensemble equality enforced; mismatch test passes.

issues_found_and_retested.issue: Staged downstream execution did not lock the original job and could race a second scratch location.
issues_found_and_retested.resolution: Original .clusterflow-run.lock plus original .orca-run.lock held over stage-in, execution and stage-out; negative tests cover both prior locks and a second scratch caller.

issues_found_and_retested.issue: The scratch identity omitted package identity and immutable sidecars, and source inputs were not revalidated after execution.
issues_found_and_retested.resolution: Scratch identity includes resolved original directory, all input hashes and executable hash; all immutable/source/config/executable hashes are checked before and after execution/copy.

issues_found_and_retested.issue: Receipt copying did not independently verify terminal job/stage/input/executable/output bindings or output-copy integrity.
issues_found_and_retested.resolution: Receipt fields and all bound output hashes are verified, nested output evidence retained, and final receipt bytes copied unchanged only after all checks.

issues_found_and_retested.issue: Check-then-copy2 could overwrite a concurrent destination, and retry could leave old property products not re-emitted by a new attempt.
issues_found_and_retested.resolution: Exclusive xb copies, full old staged-output inventory archival on explicit retry, no automatic scratch reuse, and atomic no-overwrite hard-link receipt commit last.

scientific_limitations: Unit tests use explicitly synthetic in-memory/temporary fixtures and mocks to isolate logic; they are not experimental measurements, ORCA outputs, benchmark approvals, or completed molecular calculations.
This audit did not run GOAT, DFT, NMR or J calculations. Runtime/binary/input smoke validation, if separately performed, is a separate report.
Static distance and topology checks reject obvious failures but cannot prove chemical speciation, solvation-shell completeness, or thermodynamic stability.
Unique coordinates or successful optimization do not establish independent basin discovery or global sampling convergence.
Internal solvent graph automorphisms and degeneracy are not automatically inferred; whole identical solvent component permutations are handled.
Actual experimental panel authenticity, assignments, motif coverage and scientific acceptance require accountable human review; hashes establish integrity, not truth.
No actual independent experimental J benchmark or exhaustive target/TMS sampling validation was created by this audit.
The no-revDSD workflow is a declared PBE0 shielding design and is not represented as identical electronic-structure accuracy to the full historical 51-package validation branch.
Portable runner tests are mock-only transport/integrity checks; no portable QM execution is established by this report.
Existing unreceipted outputs are intentionally blocked even with retry and require a separate import audit; partial scratch/results are retained, not automatically deleted.
Receipt atomic publication requires same-directory hard-link support. Unsupported filesystems fail closed and retain scratch; site-specific filesystem/runtime validation is still required.
Cooperative runner locks cover normal concurrent callers. Hash/lock mechanisms cannot prevent arbitrary non-cooperating external processes or manual edits at every OS-level instant.
